title: What You Sign Is Not What You Run: The Verifiability Gap in Quantized LLM Supply Chains
abstract: arXiv:2610.19498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model signing authenticates the full-precision weights W an LLM is released with, yet users run a quantized artifact Q whose producing transformation is not uniquely determined under current disclosure. We separate the non-environment inputs from the execution environment E and measure a quantity that, to our knowledge, has not been measured before: the Independent Verifiability Rate (IVR), the fraction of a popularity-sampled GGUF ecosystem that a third party can re-derive bit-for-bit. Across the 200 most-downloaded Hugging Face GGUF repositories (198 in scope), no artifact or model card records the build environment, so under a recorded-inputs protocol the IVR is 0/198. Yet the artifacts are not irreproducible. translated_title: 你所签署的并非你所运行的：量化大语言模型供应链中的可验证性差距
translated_abstract: 模型签名用于认证大语言模型发布时所附带的全精度权重 W，然而用户实际运行的是一个量化产物 Q，而在当前的披露规范下，生成该量化产物的转换过程并非唯一确定。我们将非环境输入与执行环境 E 分离，并测量了一个据我们所知此前从未被测量过的量：独立可验证率，即在按受欢迎程度抽样的 GGUF 生态系统中，第三方能够逐比特（bit-for-bit）重新推导出的产物所占的比例。在下载量最高的 200 个 Hugging Face GGUF 仓库中（198 个在研究范围内），没有任何产物或模型卡记录其构建环境，因此在“记录输入协议”下，IVR 为 0/198。然而这些产物并非不可复现。在四个披露了其输入的样本内仓库中，仅凭模型卡上的信息无法复现任何 Q4_K_M 文件，但模型卡所遗漏的两个关键坐标——构建时的浮点收缩设置，以及（针对混合模型的）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“独立可验证率（IVR）”这一新指标，发现下载量最高的 198 个 Hugging Face GGUF 量化模型仓库均未记录构建环境，导致第三方完全无法逐比特复现用户实际运行的量化产物（IVR 为 0/198），从而揭示了“已签名的全精度权重”与“实际运行的量化产物”之间的供应链可验证性鸿沟，并指出补充记录浮点收缩设置等被遗漏的构建坐标可实现复现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Independent Verifiability Rate (IVR) and shows that none of the 198 most-downloaded Hugging Face GGUF quantized model repositories record their build environments, making third-party bit-for-bit reproduction impossible (IVR 0/198), exposing a verifiability gap between signed full-precision weights and the quantized artifacts users actually run—while demonstrating that recording omitted build coordinates such as floating-point-contraction settings enables reproduction.
